title: The Azure Eye Discipline
summary: The school course in opening one great eye of soul under the azure sky and finishing with the school's unlidded eye that sees all at once.

title: Manual of the Skyward Hearing
summary: The school manual of hearing every soul from a great height and joining allies in the school's skyward choir.

title: The Crown of Many Lanterns
summary: The school's high course of lighting a crown of lanterns about the core and ruling every soul they touch.

title: Reckoning of the Boundless Basin
summary: The school's deep reckoning of a basin of soul that has no floor and no rim and holds every soul that flows to it.

title: The Windsworn Hearing Discipline
summary: The school discipline of swearing the ear of the soul to the wind and finishing with the school's all-carrying gale of hearing.

title: Oath of the Far Watch
summary: The school oath of the far watcher who swears to feel every threat to the charge before it can draw near.

title: The Unbroken Bearing Canon
summary: The school's high canon of a bearing that no trick can break and no distance can lose.

title: The Oath Beneath All Voices
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn to the quiet beneath every voice and loosed as the school's all-hearing stillness.
